brief:
Shehab Wire reported that the Al-Aqsa Flood operation of October 7, 2023, was not an isolated event but part of the natural, legitimate resistance action of Arab and international national liberation movements against occupying invaders, according to a new report. The operation, the report states, is protected under religious law and international legal frameworks.

The report frames the operation within the broader historical context of liberation struggles rather than as a singular incident, situating it within international legal protections granted to resistance against occupation.
